news:
Welcome to the Renown Realm!

- Barrens Front: tier 1 RvR lake between the Crossroads and Northwatch Hold (levels 1-19)
- War boards with daily and weekly orders at both front bases
- Renown ranks, loot bags, kill streaks and bounties
- Human Hunters
- Field mount for levels 1-39 (/fm)

Click the banner button in game for the PvP panel.
